desc: Implement prefix sum array and segment tree over prefix indices with (minP, maxP, best) combine logic; query(l, r) on nums = query over prefix indices [l, r+1].
Group indices by value; for each value x with count < n, derive gap segments between occurrences, query each non-empty segment, update global max.
Include no-op case (query(0, n-1)) and handle edge cases: single element, all-same value, all negatives, empty segments.
Brute-force cross-validate against an O(n^2 · distinct) reference on small random arrays (all-negative, single-element, all-same, duplicate-heavy) and re-verify both examples.
